scripts.typecheck: bun run --workspaces --if-present typecheck && bun run typecheck:tests
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:browser && bun run test:e2e && bun run test:mobile && bun run test:production
scripts.test:safari: bun run build:framework && vitest run --config vitest.safari.config.ts tests/browser && vitest run --config vitest.safari.config.ts tests/safari
scripts.test:safari:components: bun run build:framework && vitest run --config vitest.safari.config.ts tests/safari
scripts.test:mobile: bun run build:framework && playwright test --config playwright.mobile.config.ts
scripts.test:production: bun run build:framework && bun run --filter @micro-framework/example-host build && bun run --filter @micro-framework/example-vanilla build && bun run --filter @micro-framework/example-ssr-host build && playwright test --config playwright.production.config.ts
scripts.benchmark: bun run build:framework && bun run --filter @micro-framework/example-host build && bun run --filter @micro-framework/example-vanilla build && bun run --filter @micro-framework/example-react build && bun run --filter @micro-framework/example-vue build && bun run --filter @micro-framework/example-vue2 build && playwright test --config playwright.benchmark.config.ts
scripts.release:prepare: bun run build:framework && bun run check:artifacts && node scripts/prepare-release.mjs
scripts.test:templates: bun run release:prepare && node scripts/prepare-template-tests.mjs && playwright test --config playwright.templates.config.ts
scripts.verify: bun run check:architecture && bun run test:release && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run check:artifacts && bun run test && bun run test:templates && bun run test:integrations
scripts.test:integrations: bun run build:framework && bun run --filter @micro-framework/example-angular build && bun run --filter @micro-framework/example-angular build:webpack && playwright test --config playwright.integrations.config.ts
scripts.release:prepare:npm: bun run build:framework && bun run check:artifacts && node scripts/prepare-release.mjs --publishable
